name: Azariqa Kharijite emirate
alt: Qatari ibn al-Fuja'a's emirate in Fars and Kirman

ledger.x: 685: Second Fitna page: the Azariqa 'captured Fars and Kirman from the Zubayrids in 685'; Nafi ibn al-Azraq was killed c.685.
698: Second Fitna page: Qatari ibn al-Fuja'a 'held parts of Fars and Kirman until al-Muhallab defeated him in 698'.

698-699: Azariqa page: after Hajjaj became governor of Iraq in 694 and reinstated al-Muhallab, the Azariqa were pushed back into Kirman and 'split into two groups and were subsequently destroyed in 698-699'.

wars.name: Azariqa revolt
wars.outcome: Umayyad victory: al-Muhallab defeated Qatari in 698 and the Azariqa 'were subsequently destroyed in 698-699'.

certainty.note: A raiding army holding two provinces; the pages say 'parts of Fars and Kirman' and do not draw borders.
